title: Sutando skill manifest (v1)
description: Package identity + contract for a Sutando skill. Phase 1 of the skill-package model: extends the pre-existing manifest.json (name/enabled/access_tier/description/tools/server/startup/config) with version, owner, license, stability, compatibility, dependencies, permissions, provenance, and an I/O contract. Transport-agnostic: the same manifest is resolvable from a git repo today or a hosted registry later (only the source changes, never this format).

name.description: Skill id / slug. Lowercase, digits, dashes. Must match the skill directory name.

version.description: SemVer. MAJOR = breaking behavior/interface change; MINOR = backward-compatible feature; PATCH = fix/wording/eval improvement.

owner.description: Who maintains this skill. GitHub handle, team, or org (e.g. 'oss-agent-core', 'qingyun-wu').

license.description: SPDX id (default: the repo's license). e.g. 'MIT'.

description.description: One-line human summary; surfaced in code review, docs, and the registry.

stability.description: Trust/maturity signal. stable = guaranteed contract; experimental = unstable API/behavior; deprecated = use another skill.

agent_compatibility.description: SemVer range of the Sutando agent runtime this skill supports, e.g. '>=0.9 <2.0'. Absent = no declared constraint (assumed compatible).

dependencies.description: Other skills this one requires, as {skill-id: semver-range}.

permissions.description: Declared capabilities. The linter cross-checks these against what the skill actually touches.

oneOf.description: Vault key names the skill reads.

secrets.description: 'none', or the list of vault keys the skill needs.

contract.description: The stable I/O contract downstream depends on across versions.

guarantees.description: Behaviors guaranteed across MINOR/PATCH (e.g. 'never approves code automatically').

provenance.description: Fork lineage + build origin, so forks stay trackable and packages verifiable.

forked_from.description: Upstream package@version this was forked from, e.g. 'code-review@1.4.2'.

upstream_intent.description: Signals to upstream maintainers whether a fork's changes should be considered for merge.

enabled.description: Manifest-loaded skills only: false/missing → skipped at agent startup.

access_tier.description: Manifest-loaded skills: intended caller tier (enforcement still happens at the call-site).

tools.description: Manifest-loaded skills: relative path to a TS file exporting `tools: ToolDefinition[]`.

server.description: Manifest-loaded skills: relative path to a long-running server script (referenced for ops).

startup.description: Manifest-loaded skills: relative path to a boot script.

config.description: Manifest-loaded skills: env defaults exported at startup, only if the var is not already set (user override wins).

allOf.$comment: If the skill contributes runtime tools it must be a manifest-loaded skill (declare enabled + access_tier).
